title: 第3074章 大举入侵好言相劝第3073章 至尊间谍有内鬼
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
一尊尊黑暗古祖听从天哑古祖的建议，放弃了布置百祖夜行无上仙阵，苦心布置了这么久的阵法直接放弃，黑暗古祖们都是舍不得的，毕竟是真花了不少的心血，如今算是前功尽弃了。
不过不要紧，谁叫天哑古祖这里给出了更好的计划。
比起初来乍到的邪藤古祖，死兆古祖等强者更信任天哑古祖。
天哑古祖带着上百尊黑暗古祖潜伏在不朽长生界护界仙阵之外，耐心等待着时机。
同时暗自观察在那里劝告众人继续布阵的邪藤古祖。
“邪藤啊邪藤，你就是个小丑。”
“你的劝说起不到丝毫作用。”
天哑古祖心中都盘算好了，等到让自己的内鬼将众古祖接引进去，拿下不朽长生大界，他的威望将提升到，趁此时机将这邪藤古祖击杀了，估计其他古祖也不会说什么。
嘿嘿。
天哑古祖暗自阴恻恻的笑了，一切都在计划之中，不朽长生大界祂要，这邪藤古祖的命，祂也预定了。
“跑不了！”
“谁都跑不出本祖的手掌心。”
天哑古祖仿佛已经看见二十阶巅峰的境界在跟祂招手了。
凭祂的底蕴，一旦突破，必然有机会达到第四层次，那样的话，黑暗天祖庙可就要多增加一尊至高无上的天祖大人了。
想到这里，天哑古祖笑声都忍不住了。
“诸位，你们听我说，我真感觉这天哑古祖不对劲啊。”
“内鬼哪里有那么容易潜伏进去。”
“就算潜伏进去，又怎么可能有那么大的本事打开阵法！”
“小心中计啊。”
天哑古祖注意到洛凡尘无论如何游说都没人搭理他，不由得透出鄙夷的微笑。

小丑罢了。
不朽长生界内，四十余尊强者依旧盘膝在通天之柱之上，镇守着不朽长生界的无上仙阵。
这时，虚空中有声音传出。
“诸位，听到我的声音不要慌张，我与你们一样，都是虚空大界生灵，挫败黑暗古祖，一路追寻到了这里。”
突如其来的声音让在场所有强者都懵了一下。
“？？？”
“谁！”
“谁在暗处！”
曦帝等人目露精芒，仅仅只是一瞬间，恐怖的威压还有守护仙阵的威能都地毯式的扫荡周围，结果什么都没查出来。
“有问题！”
“真的有问题！”
雷祖瞪圆凶瞳：“我的感知没出问题。”
“确实有人躲在暗中。”
只是这么多强者齐齐施展手段，竟然都没有将洛凡尘找出来。
“嗯？”
“找不出来？”
content_en:
The ancient dark ancestors listened to the advice of the ancient ancestor Tianya and gave up on setting up the Supreme Immortal Formation of the Hundred Ancestors at Night. They had painstakingly arranged the formation for so long and just gave up. The ancient dark ancestors were reluctant to part with it. After all, they had spent a lot of effort, and now their previous efforts were all wasted.
But it doesn't matter, the ancient ancestor Tianya has a better plan here.
Compared with the powerful people such as the Evil Vine Ancient Ancestor and the Death Sign Ancient Ancestor who had just arrived, they trusted the Tianmute Ancient Ancestor more.
Ancient Ancestor Tianya and hundreds of Dark Ancestors were lurking outside the Immortal Realm Protecting Immortal Formation, patiently waiting for the opportunity.
At the same time, he secretly observed the evil vine ancestor who was there to advise everyone to continue setting up the formation.
"Eiteng, evil vine, you are a clown."
"Your persuasion has no effect at all."
Ancient Ancestor Tianya had already made a plan in his mind. When he allowed his inner ghost to bring in all the ancient ancestors and take over the Immortal Realm, his prestige would rise to the point where he would take this opportunity to kill the evil vine ancient ancestor. It is estimated that the other ancient ancestors would not say anything.
hey-hey.
Ancient Ancestor Tianya secretly smiled sadly, everything was planned. He wanted the world of immortality, and he had also predetermined the fate of the Ancient Ancestor Evil Vine.
"Can't run away!"
"No one can escape from the palm of my hand."
Ancient Ancestor Tianya seemed to have seen the peak level of the 20th level waving to him.
With his background, once he breaks through, he will definitely have the opportunity to reach the fourth level. In that case, the Dark Heavenly Ancestor Temple will have one more supreme Heavenly Ancestor.
Thinking of this, Ancient Ancestor Tianya couldn't help laughing.
"Everyone, listen to me, I really feel like something is wrong with Ancient Ancestor Tianya."
"How can a mole sneak in so easily?"
"Even if you lurk in, how can you be so capable of opening the formation!"
"Be careful of falling into a trap."
Ancient Ancestor Tianya noticed that no one paid any attention to Luo Fanchen no matter how much he tried to persuade him, and he couldn't help but smile disdainfully.
Just a clown.
In the Immortal Immortal Realm, more than forty powerful men still cross their knees on the Pillars of Heaven, guarding the Supreme Immortal Formation in the Immortal Immortal Realm.
At this time, there was a sound coming from the void.
"Everyone, don't panic when you hear my voice. Just like you, I am a creature of the void world. I defeated the ancient ancestor of darkness and pursued it all the way here."
The sudden sound made all the strong men present stunned.
"???"
"Who!"
"Who's in the dark?"
The eyes of Emperor Xi and the others were bright. Just for a moment, the terrifying pressure and the power of the guardian immortal array swept around the area like a carpet, but nothing was found.
"There's a problem!"
"There's a real problem!"
Lei Zu glared fiercely: "There is nothing wrong with my perception."
"There are indeed people hiding in the dark."
It's just that so many powerful people used their methods together, but they didn't even find Luo Fanchen.
"Huh?"
"Can't find it?"
